description: Defines the API and data structures for managing subprocesses within a Git-related project, including subprocess creation, termination, lookup, and capability negotiation.

classes.name: subprocess_entry
classes.description: Represents a subprocess, including command and process information.

classes.name: subprocess_capability
classes.description: Describes a capability that a subprocess may support.

methods.name: cmd2process_cmp
methods.description: Compares two subprocess hashmap entries for equality.

methods.name: subprocess_start
methods.description: Starts a subprocess and adds it to the hashmap.

methods.name: subprocess_stop
methods.description: Stops and removes a subprocess from the hashmap.

methods.name: subprocess_find_entry
methods.description: Finds a subprocess in the hashmap by command.

methods.name: subprocess_get_child_process
methods.description: Retrieves the underlying child_process structure from a subprocess entry.

methods.name: subprocess_handshake
methods.description: Performs version and capability negotiation with a subprocess.

methods.name: subprocess_read_status
methods.description: Reads status packets from a subprocess.
